interpretation_limits: A crop is a view, not a measurement. Nothing in this payload asserts that the region contains what you believe it contains.
--scale is nearest-neighbour: it invents no colour, and it recovers no detail the source never had. A 4x upscale of a 3-pixel feature is still a 3-pixel feature, drawn larger.

Fractional->pixel resolution rounds half up on each edge independently. resolved_pixel_rect and resolved_fractional record exactly what was cut, and they will differ from what you asked for. resolved_fractional is always frame-relative, regardless of region_space; read it and resolved_pixel_rect, not parameters.region.

region_space=foreground resolves against a foreground bounding box derived by pil_common's rule -- exact on a file with real alpha, an estimate from the border-median colour otherwise. The crop inherits that estimate's error; reference_rect records the box used.
No metadata is carried across: the output has no EXIF, no ICC profile and no text chunks, whatever the source had.
